title: Invoices: add sales tax
description:
Invoices go out without tax and finance adds it by hand. Sentry BILLING-4F2 shows the hand-off breaking: invoice totals disagree with the tax report.

Acceptance criteria:
1. Tax is computed on the invoice subtotal and rounded once, half-up, to the cent. Never round per line.
2. The invoice shows subtotal, tax and total, and total = subtotal + tax.
3. For every invoice in the BILLING-4F2 sample, our total matches the tax report to the cent.

Error tracker: https://acme.sentry.io/issues/4518821/ (BILLING-4F2)
